subject: Clarify SOC 2 coverage dates, point-in-time snapshots, and bridge letter handoff

Cc: Audits Team <audits@morganco.com>
Date: Thu, 1 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 report scope — month inclusivity & bridge letter timing

Hi Marissa,

We're preparing Acme's vendor risk review and had a few clarifying questions about Redwood's latest SOC 2 Type II package you shared earlier:

1) Report period: does the PDF labelled "20240501-20250430" include evidence for the full month of April (i.e., up to 2025-04-30 23:59:59 UTC), or is it a point-in-time snapshot taken earlier in the day?

2) If the report period ends 2025-04-30 but the report was issued in mid-May, will Redwood provide a bridge letter to confirm there were no material control changes between the period end and issuance date? If so, what date will the bridge letter cover up to?

3) For evidence requests (logs, change records) that are sampled, can you confirm whether samples include the last day of the period?

We need this for our internal memo; happy to hop on a 20-min call if easier.

Thanks,
Sonia Rao
Security Manager — Acme Corp

Hi all,

Answers below (copying the technical/compliance bits so you can paste into Acme's memo):

1) Report period inclusivity: The SOC 2 Type II report labelled "20240501-20250430" is inclusive of the entire period from 2025-05-01? Wait — typo: 2024-05-01 through 2025-04-30. The auditor performed continuous testing where applicable and point-in-time sampling for some control tests. For point-in-time controls, we treat the period end as 2025-04-30 23:59:59 UTC for scope purposes; select samples are drawn to include that date when relevant to the control objective.

2) Bridge letter: The report was issued 2025-05-15 (issuer stamp in report). We provide a standard bridge letter that covers from the report period end (2025-04-30) through the bridge letter date (we typically set this to the issuance date unless there is a later agreed-upon cutoff). Practically that means the bridge letter will state there were no material changes to the controls from 2025-04-30 through 2025-05-15. If you need coverage to a later date (e.g., through a contract effective date), let us know and we'll evaluate whether an extended letter is appropriate.

3) Sampling & evidence: For sampled evidence (change logs, deployment records), our auditors included samples that touch the last day of the period where those controls are time-bound (for example, daily deployment sign-offs). For continuous evidence (system logs, alerting), the dataset includes full retention for the period.

Attachments: we'll attach the issued PDF and a template bridge letter for review.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Controls & Compliance
Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com

Sonia — attaching the report and a draft bridge letter for Acme's file. Key points summarized in-line so your team can consume quickly: 

- Report period: May 1, 2024 through April 30, 2025 (inclusive). Point-in-time samples include the final day where applicable.
- Bridge letter: covers 2025-04-30 through 2025-05-15 (issuance date). We'll sign and return the bridge letter PDF once you confirm the wording; if you require a later coverage date, say the desired cutoff and we'll assess.
- Evidence sampling: auditors included samples referencing the last day when control objectives required it; logs for the period are retained and accessible via our evidence portal link (shared separately).

Attachments (included):
1) SOC2_Type_II_Report_20240501-20250430.pdf (PDF, 2.4MB)
2) Bridge_Letter_Templated_Response_20250515.pdf (PDF, 34KB)

Next steps for Acme: confirm if the bridge letter wording is acceptable or request an extended coverage date. If accepted, we'll provide a signed copy and a secure link to the evidence bundle.

Regards,
Marissa
